# AfriWidget

> AfriWidget is a privacy-first collection of 65 free web utilities, including calculators for health, finance, business, education, career writing, creative naming, identity testing, and African academic admissions planning.

AfriWidget provides browser-based tools with no sign-up required for everyday calculations and academic planning. The following pages are the primary African education and admissions calculators:

## BMI, BMR and TDEE Calculator

[BMI, BMR and TDEE Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/bmi-calculator) — Calculate Body Mass Index, estimated Basal Metabolic Rate, and activity-based daily energy needs privately in the browser for educational planning.

## Body Fat Calculator

[Body Fat Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/body-fat-calculator) — Estimate body fat percentage from height, waist, neck, and hip circumference measurements using a browser-only educational formula.

## Daily Calorie Needs Calculator

[Daily Calorie Needs Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/daily-calorie-needs-calculator) — Estimate BMR and daily maintenance calories from age, body size, sex category, and usual activity using Mifflin–St Jeor.

## Calorie Burn Calculator

[Calorie Burn Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/calorie-burn-calculator) — Estimate energy used during walking, running, cycling, sport, strength training, and everyday activities with MET values.

## Ideal Weight Calculator

[Ideal Weight Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ideal-weight-calculator) — Compare Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi height-based reference weight formulas without presenting a single number as a medical goal.

## Pediatric Dosage Calculator

[Pediatric Dosage Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/pediatric-dosage-calculator) — Estimate a child’s weight-based liquid paracetamol or ibuprofen dose in millilitres; confirm all medicine decisions with a doctor or pharmacist.

## Ovulation and Cycle Calculator

[Ovulation and Cycle Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ovulation-cycle-calculator) — Estimate next-period timing, fertile window, ovulation peak, and lower-risk cycle days from calendar inputs.

## Daily Water Intake Calculator

[Daily Water Intake Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/water-intake-calculator) — Estimate a daily hydration goal in litres, millilitres, and 500 mL bottles using weight, exercise, and climate.

## Healthy Weight Range Calculator

[Healthy Weight Range Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/healthy-weight-range-calculator) — Estimate an adult height-based reference range using BMI thresholds, with clear limitations and educational guidance.

## Hydration Reminder Calculator

[Hydration Reminder Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/hydration-reminder-calculator) — Create a flexible local drinking schedule from a daily target, waking hours, and reminder interval without storing data or sending notifications.

## Calorie Deficit Planner

[Calorie Deficit Planner](https://afriwidget.com/calorie-deficit-planner) — Compare estimated maintenance calories with a 500 kcal daily deficit using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.

## Blood Donation Eligibility Calculator

[Blood Donation Eligibility Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/blood-donation-eligibility-calculator) — Check a basic age, weight, and re-donation interval planning screen and calculate the earliest next donation date.

## WASSCE Aggregate Calculator

[WASSCE Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/wassce-aggregate-calculator) — Calculate a Ghanaian WASSCE tertiary admission aggregate from core subjects and the best three elective grades.

## BECE Aggregate Calculator

[BECE Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/bece-aggregate-calculator) — Estimate a Ghanaian BECE Senior High School placement aggregate from core subjects and the best optional grades.

## JAMB UTME Aggregate Calculator

[JAMB UTME Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/jamb-utme-aggregate-calculator) — Estimate a Nigerian JAMB UTME and O’Level aggregate for university admissions planning.

## Tertiary GPA and CGPA Calculator

[Tertiary GPA and CGPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tertiary-gpa-cgpa-calculator) — Calculate semester GPA and cumulative CGPA using course grades and credit units on 4.0 or 5.0 scales.

## South African APS Calculator

[South African APS Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/south-african-aps-calculator) — Estimate a South African Matric or NSC Admission Point Score from subject percentages, with optional Life Orientation points.

## KCSE and KUCCPS Cluster Calculator

[KCSE and KUCCPS Cluster Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kcse-kuccps-cluster-calculator) — Estimate a Kenyan KCSE aggregate and mean grade from seven subject results for KUCCPS and tertiary planning.

## University Cut-Off and Eligibility Checker

[University Cut-Off and Eligibility Checker](https://afriwidget.com/university-cutoff-eligibility-checker) — Compare JAMB or WASSCE scores with sample university course baselines as an admissions planning estimate.

## WAEC / NECO O’Level Subject Combination Checker

[WAEC / NECO O’Level Subject Combination Checker](https://afriwidget.com/olevel-subject-combination-checker) — Check common core and elective subject combinations for popular West African university courses.

## KCSE Eligibility Tier Checker

[KCSE Eligibility Tier Checker](https://afriwidget.com/kcse-eligibility-tier-checker) — Map a Kenyan KCSE mean grade to degree, diploma, craft, or artisan planning tiers.

## South African TVET NATED Pass Calculator

[South African TVET NATED Pass Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/south-african-tvet-nated-calculator) — Calculate a weighted NATED final mark from ICASS and final examination marks.

## BECE CSSPS School Placement Estimator

[BECE CSSPS School Placement Estimator](https://afriwidget.com/bece-cssps-placement-estimator) — Compare a Ghanaian BECE aggregate with indicative Category A, B, and C placement bands.

## IGCSE / A-Level to US GPA Converter

[IGCSE / A-Level to US GPA Converter](https://afriwidget.com/igcse-alevel-gpa-converter) — Convert IGCSE, AS-Level, and A-Level grades into an indicative US-style GPA.

## All AfriWidget Tools

[All AfriWidget Tools](https://afriwidget.com/widgets) — Browse the complete collection of AfriWidget calculators and browser-based utilities.

## Productivity Tools

[Productivity Tools](https://afriwidget.com/productivity) — Use 29 browser-based productivity and creative tools for invoices, career writing, email, profiles, text cleanup, JSON, passwords, mock identity data, naming, dates, colors, SEO, data conversion, images, and WhatsApp links.
